title: IIG Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
summary: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is recruiting for one Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I post. Candidates with an M.Sc. in Physics or a B.S.-M.S. in Physics can apply starting from 25 November 2026 until 14 December 2026. The selected candidate will work on an ANRF-sponsored project at IIG Headquarters in New Panvel.
qualification: M.Sc. in Physics, or B.S.-M.S. (5-year Integrated) in Physics with First Class.
salary: Rs. 37,000 + HRA (CSIR-UGC NET or GATE), Rs. 30,000 + HRA (others)
summary_hindi: भारतीय भूचुंबक विज्ञान संस्थान एक जूनियर रिसर्च फेलो/प्रोजेक्ट एसोसिएट-I पद के लिए भर्ती कर रहा है। भौतिकी में एम.एससी. या भौतिकी में बी.एस.-एम.एस. वाले उम्मीदवार 25 नवंबर 2026 से 14 दिसंबर 2026 तक आवेदन कर सकते हैं। चयनित उम्मीदवार आईआईजी मुख्यालय, न्यू पनवेल में एक एएनआरएफ-प्रायोजित परियोजना पर काम करेंगे।
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Indian Institute of Geomagnetism.
Fill in the online application form.
Upload any required documents as per instructions.
Submit the application before the deadline.
overview: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is looking to fill one position for a Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I. This role involves participating in research on magnetospheric transients, which is crucial for understanding space weather and its implications on technology.

Candidates suitable for this position should have a strong academic background in Physics, either through a Master's program or a 5-year integrated Bachelor's-Master's degree. The role is ideal for those interested in research and willing to contribute to projects that explore geophysics and space environments.

This recruitment reflects the institute's commitment to advancing research in geomagnetism and related fields. Candidates should ensure they meet the educational and age requirements before applying, and they should prepare for an interview if shortlisted.
about_organization: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. It focuses on research in geomagnetism and allied fields, providing facilities for experimental studies and high-performance computing.
eligibility_notes: Candidates must possess specified qualifications in Physics. A relaxation of 5% marks is available for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer), PwBD, and EWS candidates per UGC guidelines. There are no extra age relaxations stated in the notification.
preparation_tips: Review fundamental concepts in physics, particularly those related to geomagnetism.
Familiarize yourself with research methodologies and satellite data analysis, as these may be relevant to the role.
Practice programming in relevant languages such as MATLAB, C++, or Python, which may help in project tasks.
